description.narrative: The Project is anticipated to increase domestic value addition and job creation through up- and down-stream linkages with related sectors and increase food security for consumers through increased local production and distribution of quality and safe food products. The investment is expected to sustain market resilience against shocks by supporting Foodtec's expansion and utilization of grain handling and milling capacities. Angola and neighboring countries such as Zambia, the DRC, Namibia and Botswana have underdeveloped food systems and mostly import food products which make them vulnerable to shocks such as forex fluctuations and volatility of prices of food and raw materials. These aggravate food shortages and losses and food insecurity which the investment intends to address.

The proposed investment is a senior A Loan of up to EUR 40 million to Naval Holding Limited (Naval Groupor, The Group), a diversified industrial conglomerate with headquarters in Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and operational leadership based in Luanda, Angola. The investment supports Naval Group's expansion of its Angolan subsidiary, Foodtec Industria Alimentar, Lda (Foodtec, The Company), a leading food manufacturer in Angola operating a wheat mill and pasta lines (the Project).
